title: Habitat & Wildlife Maps
selected_by_owner: Owner directed the next standalone MMHT cycle.

in_scope: Draw, redraw and label flora zones, habitat areas, sanctuaries, seasonal migration corridors, wildlife observations and encounter anchors.
Link mapped features to stable creature identities from the CEW-01 ledger or an explicit external reference ID.
Preserve season filters, geometry, corridor widths, and player/GM map reference permissions.
boundaries: Owner-approved map authoring only. Ship and vehicle operations, base construction, farming, extraction, ecology simulation and other gameplay engines retain their owner-domain scope. Map features may store typed references for later integration.
Standalone artifact confirmation is separate from installed product integration and owner playtest feedback.

evidence.validation: Executed the packaged HTML with JSDOM and native Canvas. Verified season switching and restored viewport, authoring and redraw of a width-bearing migration path with a CEW identity, undo/redo, restricted observation IDs and notes omitted from player references, authored level-specific encounter marker, and prior workspace compatibility. Strict TypeScript retains the existing MCS-03 operationId narrowing error.
evidence.example: Havalaea Canopy & Basin Survey includes a spring canopy passage, autumn basin passage, flora zone, seasonal reed pools, sanctuary and mapped encounter/observation markers. Scenario routes are editable examples.
evidence.boundaries: Authored habitat geography and identity references only. CEW/ENV and campaign authorities retain suitability, distribution, frequency and encounter behavior. Physical Android testing remains pending.

next_action: Review the seasonal map and role-filtered exports in the standalone HTML. Use feedback for Farm & Forage Maps when MMHT-08 is selected.
successor_rule: Requires owner direction to start the next standalone review cycle.

last_material_progress.evidence: MMHT-07 offline HTML, artifact checksum, and executed habitat, seasonal, and role filtering checks.

stop_reason.evidence: Habitat and migration authoring, seasonal selection and role-filtered handoffs were saved and passed standalone verification.
